notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
The time has come for a big update.
List of changes:
1) Many bugs and errors in the text have been fixed.
2) New bugs and errors in the text have been added :)
3) The game received new scenes, locations, puzzles and a complete plot.
4) The mention of episode 2 was removed (now the game is complete and finished).
5) 2 endings were added.
6)Several levels have been removed.

notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
A huge update has been released and here is a list of the main changes:
*Added English language.
* Added new puzzles, rooms, dialogues, pictures.
* Many bugs fixed.
* The first episode is completely ready.

In the next updates we should expect bug fixes that we already know about.
